_help: F-37 auction house (scripts/Auction.cs engine, scripts/NetAuction.cs online server, scripts/UiAuction.cs window). rules: feePct = listing fee as % of the start price, paid up front and never refunded (feeMin gold at least); taxPct = % of the sale price kept by the house when a listing sells; durations = allowed listing lengths in hours (offline one hour = offlineHourSec seconds of PlayerStats.Played, online one hour = onlineHourSec real seconds); a new bid must be at least the current bid + max(minBidStep, minBidStepPct %); maxListings per hero; maxPrice caps every price; pageSize listings per page; maxBook = most open listings the online book accepts. value: what things are 'worth' to NPC buyers: an item = Item.Value x itemMul + itemAdd (the shop's buy price), a pet = pet.<rarity> x (1 + petPerLevel x (level - 1)) plus its gear. npc (offline only): the house keeps about 'stock' NPC listings (of them 'pets' pets), adding up to restockPerHour each game hour; items are rolled at the hero's level +- levelSpread with loot bonus lootBonus, petGearChance of them pet gear; start price = value x startMin..startMax, buyout = value x buyoutMin..buyoutMax (noBuyoutChance: none); names = NPC sellers and buyers. npc.buyers: each game hour, per listing of the hero, an NPC buys out with chance buyoutChance x K(buyout / value), else bids the minimum with chance bidChance x K(next bid / value), where K(r) = clamp((maxRatio - r) / (maxRatio - 1), 0, bargainBoost): at r = 1 (a fair price) K = 1, at maxRatio or above nothing sells, bargains sell faster. rivalChance: per game hour an NPC outbids the hero on an NPC listing while the next bid is at most rivalMaxRatio x value (the hero's gold comes back to the Collect tab).
